title: De-AI this draft passage
description: The system first flags which passages read like boilerplate, then produces one revision to compare. Recurring issues are collected into rule suggestions you decide whether to bring back to the formula editor.
placeholder: Paste a passage you want to de-AI first.
runFirst: Run a check first; the result tells you which passages sound most like AI and why they break immersion.
diffDescription: Lightweight line-by-line comparison per paragraph to judge whether the revision is reducing boilerplate feel or accidentally losing the original voice.
emptyDiff: After one revision, the before/after comparison appears here.
suggestions: Recurring issues worth fixing into rules
suggestionsDescription: This version doesn't auto-write to the system; issues are first collected into suggestions you decide whether to lock into the current formula.
emptySuggestions: Once issues are detected, savable rule suggestions appear here.
